name: torrent-webui
description: Authenticated LAN WebUI bundled with TorrentWebUiForAndroid

scripts.test:policy: npm run test:e2e:m4:static && npm run test:e2e:m6:clean-install:policy && npm run test:e2e:m6:interruption:policy && npm run test:e2e:m6:port:policy
scripts.test:ci: npm run licenses:check && npm run check && npm run test:policy && npm run test:browser
scripts.test:e2e:m4:static: node --check e2e/m4-official-torrents.mjs && node --check e2e/m4-live.mjs && node --check e2e/m4-runner.mjs && node --test e2e/m4-private-state.test.mjs e2e/m4-official-torrents.test.mjs
scripts.e2e:m6:clean-install: npm run copy-assets && cd .. && ./gradlew :app:assembleDebug --console=plain && cd web && node e2e/m6-clean-install-runner.mjs
scripts.e2e:m6:interruption: npm run copy-assets && cd .. && ./gradlew :app:assembleDebug --console=plain && cd web && npm run e2e:m6:interruption:migration && npm run e2e:m6:interruption:journey
scripts.e2e:m6:port: npm run copy-assets && cd .. && ./gradlew :app:assembleDebug --console=plain && cd web && node e2e/m6-port-lifecycle-runner.mjs
scripts.e2e:m4:live: npm run copy-assets && cd .. && ./gradlew :app:installDebug --console=plain && cd web && node e2e/m4-runner.mjs
